entries.label: Pasta alla Carbonara
entries.prompt: Create ONE finished Minecraft item texture for Italian's Delight, STRICTLY matching the attached Farmer's Delight Refabricated sprites. This is an actual SIXTEEN BY SIXTEEN (16x16) pixel-art sprite, not a detailed illustration. If enlarged for output, every logical pixel must be a perfectly flat solid square on a 16x16 grid, with no smaller subpixels, gradients, blur, antialiasing, glow or soft edges. Transparent background; every foreground pixel 100% opaque, background 0% opaque. References: image 1 is the main Farmer's Delight item style/bowl reference; image 2 is a sheet of original Farmer's Delight items for palette, proportion and level of simplification only. Produce only one item, no sheet, no labels. Preserve the reference's squat dark brown wooden bowl, its dark umber outline, low right-side shadow, ochre rim, position near the lower third, shallow three-quarter view, and the scale of the food mound above it. Match the original restrained flat palette and chunky pixel clusters, readable at 16x16. Bowl spans about 14-16 logical pixels across and is only 4 pixels tall; do not use ceramic or a deep soup bowl. No utensil, steam, garnish unrelated to the dish, surrounding scene, cast shadow or background. The art must look like another official Farmer's Delight food item placed next to the references. Dish: spaghetti alla carbonara. Replace the meatballs/tomato from the reference with a compact nest of GOLDEN EGG-YOLK yellow pasta strands, creamy warm yellow highlights, 3-4 small dark reddish-brown guanciale cubes, and only 2 tiny charcoal black pepper pixels. The creamy yellow food must dominate. Distinct bent 2-3 pixel noodle clusters; no large meatball, no red tomato sauce, no green parsley, no fried egg on top. Use about 14-18 opaque palette colors including the bowl.
